comment: MoeH5 is a flexible carbohydrate tailoring enzyme performing carboxyamidation using substrates, such as glycine, ammonia and C5N unit to convert the carboxyl group of  terminal sugar of moenomycins (galacturonic acid) into carboxyamidated products - nosokomycins B, moenomycin G, moenomycin A

changelog.comment: New entry. Reviewer 2 made reaction more generalized by removing balancing reactants O, N.

reactions.description: Carboxyamidation of terminal galacturonate of nosokomycin A with ammonia as a donor substrate
carboxyamidation of ammonia ion and nosokomycin A
